Tight black lips and black open-nostril nose, moderate dark oval-to-round nonbulging eyes visible through natural parted facial furnishing. Moderate strong slightly arched clean neck, proud head carriage, elbow-deep broad oval chest, broad straight level back, taut level loin, gently sloped croup and slight firm tuck. profileEvidence.summary: Lively, affectionate and responsive, the Kyi-Leo is described as a trusting, loyal companion. Its breed standard also emphasizes a calm, gentle manner. The breed developed from Lhasa Apso–Maltese stock, with Harriet Linn organizing its development from 1965 and working with other kennels before formalization in the 1970s.
